title: Kansai temples, food and Uji
titleJa: 京都・大阪・奈良・宇治
summary: D6 Shinkansen to Kyoto, Fushimi Inari at dusk · D7 Kinkakuji + Arashiyama (early morning for snow) · D8 Uji: Hibike! Euphonium spots + Byodoin + matcha · D9 Nara deer + Todaiji · D10 Osaka Dotonbori food · D11 Kobe beef + Arima Onsen · D12 fly KIX→New Chitose · D13 Otaru + Sapporo · D14 Sapporo, fly out. Or stop at D11 and fly home from Kansai (KIX).
why: Gives temples, food and one anime pilgrimage (Euphonium) with no long drives, and still ends in snowy Hokkaido if they want.
cost: transport approx. ¥35,000–55,000 pp (Tokyo→Kyoto Shinkansen ~¥14,200, local trains ~¥10,000, KIX→Chitose LCC ~¥8,000–20,000). Flight change: open-jaw, arrive Narita, leave from KIX (or CTS if the Hokkaido tail is kept). Loses Zao/Niseko skiing.
winterNote: Kyoto city gets settled snow only on a few days per winter (need 3–5 cm after a cold wave; go at opening time). Plan for cold, clear weather; snow is a bonus.
anime: Hibike! Euphonium (Uji Bridge, Daikichiyama lookout, Uji Shrine)

title: Japan Alps and Shirakawa-go loop
titleJa: 北陸・飛騨・信州 周遊
summary: D6 (Sun Jan 24) Shinkansen to Kanazawa, evening Shirakawa-go light-up (reservation) · D7 Takayama old town + Hida-Furukawa (Your Name) · D8 Takayama (Hyouka) → Matsumoto Castle · D9–10 Hakuba ski · D11 snow monkeys at Jigokudani + Shibu Onsen night · D12 Nagano → Tokyo · D13–14 Tokyo free days, fly from Tokyo.
why: Mixes two anime settings, a famous snow village, real Alps skiing for Pegasis and easy slopes for Aoki, and onsen monkeys.
cost: transport approx. ¥45,000–60,000 pp (Tokyo→Kanazawa ~¥14,400, Nohi buses Kanazawa–Shirakawa-go–Takayama ~¥6,000, Takayama→Matsumoto bus ~¥3,900, Nagano→Tokyo ~¥8,300, local buses). Light-up bus tours cost extra. Flight change: in and out of Tokyo; no Hokkaido.
winterNote: 2027 Shirakawa-go light-up: Jan 11, 17, 24, 31, 17:30–19:30, reservation only (parking from Sep 10 and Dec 1, lodging lottery Oct 1–31 2026, bus tours from Oct 13 2026). Jan 24 = baseline day 6. Jigokudani car road is closed in winter; walk 35 min from Kambayashi.
anime: Hyouka (Takayama town), Your Name (Hida-Furukawa station and library)

title: Kyushu: Goto islands and onsen drive
titleJa: 九州：五島列島・阿蘇・別府
summary: D6 fly Haneda→Fukuoka, Hakata yatai stalls · D7 fly to Goto Fukue, rent car, Aokana spots (samurai street, Takahama Beach, Osezaki Lighthouse) · D8 Goto, fly back · D9 car to Kumamoto Castle · D10 Aso crater area + Milk Road → Kurokawa Onsen · D11 Yamanami Highway → Yufuin · D12 Beppu hells + sand bath · D13 back to Fukuoka · D14 fly home from Fukuoka.
why: Warmer roads let Aoki drive a lot, it has a rare anime island, and some of Japan's best onsen towns.
cost: transport approx. ¥60,000–85,000 pp (Haneda→Fukuoka ~¥12,000–30,000, Fukuoka⇄Fukue ~¥11,000 each way on ANA/ORC, rental car 6 days + fuel + tolls split by 2 ~¥30,000). Flight change: return from Fukuoka (FUK) — direct to Shanghai; Pegasis connects via Tokyo or Seoul. No skiing, no Hokkaido.
winterNote: Kyushu is mild (5–10 °C) but Aso and the Yamanami Highway can freeze or close after snow; ask the rental shop for snow tyres. Goto flights can cancel in strong winter wind.
anime: Aokana: Four Rhythm Across the Blue (Fukue Island, Goto)

title: Hokkaido deep: drift ice and powder
titleJa: 北海道周遊：流氷とパウダースノー
summary: D6 fly Haneda→Memanbetsu, Abashiri · D7 icebreaker Aurora, drive to Shiretoko Utoro · D8 drift-ice walk at Utoro · D9 Lake Mashu, Kawayu Onsen, swans at Lake Kussharo · D10 red-crowned cranes at Tsurui/Kushiro → Tomamu · D11 Tomamu ski + Ice Village · D12 Furano ski · D13 Asahikawa zoo + Biei Blue Pond · D14 Sapporo, fly out (Tohoku skipped).
why: Pure snow country: drift ice, cranes, Hokkaido powder for Pegasis and wide easy runs for Aoki, with long snowy drives for Aoki.
cost: transport approx. ¥60,000–90,000 pp (Haneda→Memanbetsu ~¥15,000–30,000, rental car 8 days + one-way drop fee + fuel split by 2 ~¥45,000–55,000, Aurora ship ¥7,000). Flight change: none for home flights (still ends Sapporo); Zao, Sendai, Hakodate and Niseko drop out.
winterNote: Aurora icebreaker runs Jan 20–Mar 31 2027, but drift ice usually reaches Abashiri only around late January and is best in February; if no ice, the cruise still runs. Eastern Hokkaido roads are icy; long drives in the dark are risky.

title: Tokyo base with day trips
summary: D6 Shinkansen to GALA Yuzawa ski (station is at the ski base) · D7 Nikko Toshogu + Kegon Falls · D8 bus to Kusatsu Onsen, stay in a ryokan · D9 Kusatsu ski → Tokyo · D10 Kamakura + Enoshima (Slam Dunk crossing) · D11 Hakone onsen + ropeway · D12 GALA ski again or Kawagoe · D13 Tokyo shopping · D14 Tokyo, fly out. One hotel for most nights.
why: Least packing and moving, still gives ski days, onsen and Fuji views, and keeps Tokyo nights for anime and car meets.
cost: transport approx. ¥40,000–55,000 pp (GALA Yuzawa Shinkansen round trip ~¥14,000 x1–2, Nikko ~¥6,000, Kusatsu bus ~¥5,000 each way, Hakone Free Pass ~¥6,100, Kamakura ~¥2,000). Flight change: round trip to Tokyo only (simplest, cheapest flights).
winterNote: GALA Yuzawa usually opens mid-December to early May. Nikko roads above Kegon can be icy; trains and buses run.

title: JDM road trip: Izu to Gunma
titleJa: 伊豆・富士・信州・群馬 ドライブ旅
summary: D6 rent car in Tokyo, Izu Skyline + Shuzenji Onsen · D7 Fuji Motorsports Museum at Fuji Speedway → Kawaguchiko · D8 Yamanashi → Tateshina, ice-driving class at Lake Megami (booked event) · D9 Karuizawa → Ikaho, drive Haruna (Initial D Akina) in daylight · D10 Akagi view + Kusatsu Onsen · D11 back to Tokyo, return car · D12 guided JDM tour / Daikoku PA night · D13–14 Tokyo, fly out.
why: Most driving of all options for Aoki, real ice practice, Initial D roads and car museums, with onsen every night on the road.
cost: approx. ¥55,000–80,000 pp (4WD rental with studless tyres 6 days ~¥60,000–90,000, tolls ~¥20,000, fuel ~¥15,000, split by 2) + ice-driving event ~¥47,000 per car (2026 price, own car often required — check if rental cars are allowed). Flight change: in and out of Tokyo; no Hokkaido.
winterNote: Lake Megami ice sessions ran Jan 19–20 and Feb 6–7 in 2026; 2027 dates not yet found. Haruna and Akagi roads freeze in winter: studless tyres needed, go only in daylight and dry weather. Pegasis cannot drive rentals (1-year licence).
anime: Initial D (Mt Haruna = Akina, Mt Akagi)

title: Shift dates for Sapporo Snow Festival
titleJa: さっぽろ雪まつりに合わせて日程変更
summary: Keep the baseline route but move it to Thu Jan 28 – Thu Feb 11 (15 days). D1–5 Tokyo/Fuji Jan 28–Feb 1 · D6–7 Zao + Sendai Feb 2–3 · D8 Hakodate Feb 4 · D9–10 Niseko Feb 5–6 · D11 Otaru Snow Light Path Feb 7 · D12–13 Asahikawa + Biei Feb 8–9 · D14 Sapporo Snow Festival Feb 10 · D15 fly home Feb 11.
why: Adds Japan's biggest winter festival and Otaru's candle festival, and drift ice and snow monsters are better in February.
cost: same transport as baseline; Sapporo/Otaru hotels during the festival are often 2–3x normal price, book early. Flight change: new dates only (in Narita, out New Chitose). Aoki's 15-day visa: Jan 28 – Feb 11 is exactly 15 days.
winterNote: 2027 Sapporo Snow Festival: Feb 4–11 (Odori, Susukino, Tsudome). Otaru Snow Light Path: Feb 6–13, 2027. Asahikawa Winter Festival 2027 confirmed for early Feb, exact dates not yet out. Chinese New Year is Feb 6, 2027: Shanghai flights and Japan crowds will peak.

title: Hokkaido snow to Okinawa sun
summary: Baseline to D11 (Otaru/Sapporo), then: D12 fly New Chitose→Naha, Kokusai-dori · D13 rental car north: Kouri Bridge, Churaumi Aquarium, early cherry blossoms at Yaedake · D14 Naha, Shurijo area + beach walk; fly home from Naha. Or skip Hokkaido and do Tokyo → Okinawa for D11–14.
why: A warm 17–20 °C ending after two weeks of snow, with an easy coast drive for Aoki and Japan's earliest sakura.
cost: transport approx. ¥25,000–45,000 pp (New Chitose→Naha direct ~¥15,000–35,000, rental car 2 days split by 2 ~¥8,000, Churaumi ¥2,180). Flight change: return from Naha (OKA) — direct to Shanghai; Pegasis connects via Tokyo. Loses Asahiyama zoo, Biei and Furano.
winterNote: Motobu Yaedake Sakura Festival started mid/late January in 2026 (extended to Feb 8); 2027 dates not yet announced. January also has humpback whale tours from Naha. Sea is too cold for most people to swim.
